text: Given a valid mailbox identity and trustee, When exo_add_mailbox_permission(identity, user) is called, Then the trustee is granted FullAccess and the response names the mailbox, the user and FullAccess
Given exo_add_mailbox_permission is called with auto_mapping=False, When the grant succeeds, Then the request sent to Exchange carries AutoMapping=false

Given a mailbox identity and a trustee currently holding FullAccess, When exo_remove_mailbox_permission(identity, user) is called, Then the trustee's FullAccess is revoked and the response names the mailbox and the user

Given a valid mailbox identity and trustee, When exo_add_recipient_permission(identity, trustee) is called, Then the trustee is granted SendAs and the response names the mailbox, the trustee and SendAs

Given a mailbox identity and a trustee currently holding SendAs, When exo_remove_recipient_permission(identity, trustee) is called, Then the trustee's SendAs is revoked and the response names the mailbox and the trustee

Given a mailbox with 2 trustees holding FullAccess plus the implicit NT AUTHORITY\SELF grant, When exo_get_mailbox_permission(identity) is called without user, Then the response lists exactly those 2 trustees and excludes SELF
Given a mailbox and a specific trustee holding FullAccess, When exo_get_mailbox_permission(identity, user=<trustee>) is called, Then the response contains only that trustee's entry
Given a mailbox and a trustee with no FullAccess grant, When exo_get_mailbox_permission(identity, user=<that trustee>) is called, Then the response is an empty list, not an error
Given a mailbox with 1 trustee holding SendAs, When exo_get_recipient_permission(identity) is called without trustee, Then the response lists that trustee
Given a mailbox and a specific trustee holding SendAs, When exo_get_recipient_permission(identity, trustee=<trustee>) is called, Then the response contains only that trustee's entry
Given an identity that does not resolve to a real mailbox, When any of the 6 tools is called, Then the response is {"error":{"code":"not_found",...}}, not a raised exception
Given a user/trustee that does not resolve to a real recipient, When exo_add_mailbox_permission or exo_add_recipient_permission is called, Then the response is the same not_found envelope
Given no Exchange Online credentials are present on the request, When any of the 6 tools is called, Then the response is the existing NO_CREDENTIALS envelope

Given two concurrent requests carrying two different tenants' credentials, When any of the 6 tools runs for each, Then each call is routed to its own tenant's admin endpoint and neither response leaks the other tenant's data

Given this connector is already connected on the platform, When the 6 new tools are deployed and an operator presses Refresh Tools on the connector detail page, Then all 6 appear in the per-connector tool list with name and one-line description, with no other platform-side change
steps: Deploy the rebuilt exchange_online_mcp container with permissions.py included
In the platform UI, open the already-connected Exchange Online connector's detail page
expect: The tool list grows from 7 to 13 rows; the 6 new rows are exo_add_mailbox_permission, exo_remove_mailbox_permission, exo_add_recipient_permission, exo_remove_recipient_permission, exo_get_mailbox_permission, exo_get_recipient_permission, each with an Available badge; no other page or setting needed to be touched
notes: Blocked on a deployed instance with a connected Exchange Online connector; not executable from the design flow (no EXO tenant reachable). Dev leg to execute once deployed, or record as a deliberate manual-only gap if no such environment exists at dev time.
